龙国篇龙国篇第三章世界蛇的王（上）
“武神禁术·无色墙？”
艾希一脸疑惑不解地看着眼前之人，心中充满了疑问，“你怎么可能会施展这种最强武神禁术呢？你到底是谁？”
黑衣人听到艾希的质问后，突然放声大笑起来：“最强禁术？学起来和用起来也不过如此嘛！
实在是太过弱小了！
好啦！
既然你这么想知道我是谁，那就睁大眼睛看清楚吧！”
说罢，他十分豪爽地脱去了身上的那件黑色大衣以及口罩，展露出一张英俊帅气的面庞。
与此同时，他手中握着的那把剑闪烁出耀眼的蓝色光芒。
“我便是世界蛇之王——凯王！”
“哈哈哈哈……好好见识一下，什么才是真正的SSS级武神！”
只见凯王轻松挥出一剑，便如同切豆腐一般将那厚厚的云层斩断开来。
凯王满脸骄傲地说道：“这一招，风神·斩空。”
紧接着又是一剑挥出，五百里范围内的所有云层眨眼间便消失得无影无踪。
“风神·风化。”
这时，天空上的异常不得不让战场上每一个武神都不得不注意，其中就有一位女武神被吓到差点失声“这压迫感、这力量，难道是他?凯王，世界蛇的领袖!”
她心中一惊，第一时间便掏出了无线电磁波对讲器，声音急促地向大家喊道：“艾希和阿恒现在处境十分危险！
凯王这个敌人非常强大，远非他们两个人能够应付得了的！
这个敌人的实力强大到我们难以想象，如果我们所有人齐心协力、共同对敌或许还能有一战之力……”
她的话音未落，战场上的所有武神都不禁打了一个寒战，异口同声地惊呼道：“什么？凯王？”

“没错，就是那个男人！
想必大家也都注意到刚才天空中的异样情况了吧！
方圆五百里内的云层竟然在一瞬间被斩断消失了！
仅仅凭借这一点，我就能肯定就是他！
刚才的云层正是被他的风神·斩空所斩开的，紧接着又是风神·风化，眨眼间就让云层彻底消散无踪！”
她一边说着，一边陷入了短暂的沉思之中，“两年前的一次任务中，我曾经有幸与凯王交手过。
那时的他就已经强大到令人畏惧的地步，手持神之剑，轻轻一挥，整座阿埃徳宫殿就如同豆腐一般被斩成了一片平地，而那场战斗几乎就在瞬息之间便已结束。”
此时此刻，所有武神皆是震惊不已，失声惊呼道：“仅仅只需一剑？那座宫殿可是足有两个公里之巨啊！
并且，宫殿还是金光石与神龙石所打造而成，坚不可摧”
她不禁陷入沉思之中，喃喃自语道：“没错，实在是强大得令人心悸，想当年，即便那时的我已然身为S级武神，却也无法阻挡那一剑的威势，更遑论如今的他呢！”
就在丽莎听闻卡娜的对话之时，心中更是惊愕万分，当下毫不迟疑地发出命令，让战场之上的所有武神即刻前往支援叶恒与艾希二人。
艾希望着眼前这个实力深不可测、无可匹敌的强敌，再瞧了一眼已经被注射过镇定剂而昏迷不醒的叶恒，没有丝毫犹豫，转身便朝着远方疾驰而逃。
凯王一脸高傲地笑了起来，仿佛对眼前的敌人不屑一顾一般："
跑吧，弱小的武神们！
你们根本不是我的对手！
伴随着他轻蔑的笑声，凯王再次高举手中的剑，全力斩向了艾希。

Dragon Kingdom Arc Dragon Kingdom Arc Chapter 3 The King of the World Snake (Part 1)
"Forbidden Technique of the God of War: Colorless Wall?"
Ai Xi looked at the person in front of him with a puzzled expression, and his heart was full of questions, "How could you possibly cast this most powerful martial arts forbidden technique? Who are you?"
After hearing Ai Xi's question, the man in black suddenly laughed loudly: "The most powerful forbidden technique? It can only be learned and used like this!"
It's really too weak!
OK!
Since you want to know who I am so much, then open your eyes and see clearly! "
After that, he took off the black coat and mask very boldly, revealing a handsome and handsome face.
At the same time, the sword he held in his hand shone with a dazzling blue light.
"I am the snake king of the world - King Kai!"
"Hahahaha... let's see what a true SSS-level Martial God is!"
King Kai easily swung his sword and cut through the thick clouds like tofu.
King Kai said with pride: "This move, Fengshen Zhankong."
Then he swung his sword again, and all the clouds within a radius of five hundred miles disappeared without a trace in the blink of an eye.
"Wind God·Feng Hua."
At this time, the abnormality in the sky had to draw the attention of every valkyrie on the battlefield. One of them was so frightened that one of the valkyries almost lost her voice. "This sense of oppression and power, could it be him? King Kai, the leader of the World Snake!"
She was startled, and she immediately took out the radio electromagnetic wave intercom and shouted to everyone in a rapid voice: "Ai Xi and Ah Heng are in very danger now!
The enemy King Kai is very powerful, far beyond what the two of them can handle!
The strength of this enemy is beyond our imagination. If we all work together and fight against the enemy together, we may still be able to fight..."
Before she finished speaking, all the Martial Gods on the battlefield couldn't help but shudder and exclaimed in unison: "What? King Kai?"
"Yes, that's the man!
Everyone must have noticed the strange situation in the sky just now!
The clouds within a radius of five hundred miles were cut off and disappeared in an instant!
Based on this alone, I am sure it is him!
The clouds just now were cut open by his Wind God, Zhankong, and then followed by Wind God, Fenghua, and the clouds completely dissipated without a trace in the blink of an eye! "
As she spoke, she fell into a brief thought, "During a mission two years ago, I had the honor to fight against King Kai.
At that time, he was already so powerful that it was terrifying. With a single wave of the God's Sword, the entire Aed Palace was cut to the ground like tofu, and the battle ended almost instantly. "
At this moment, all the Martial Gods were shocked and exclaimed: "Just one sword? That palace is two kilometers long!
Moreover, the palace is made of golden light stone and divine dragon stone and is indestructible."
She couldn't help but fell into deep thought and murmured to herself: "Yes, it is so powerful that it makes people feel heart-stopping. I think back then, even though I was already an S-class Martial God at that time, I couldn't stop the power of that sword, let alone him now!"
When Lisa heard Kana's conversation, she was even more shocked. She immediately issued an order without hesitation, asking all the Martial Gods on the battlefield to immediately go to support Ye Heng and Ai Xi.
Ai hoped that this unfathomable and unrivaled enemy in front of him took another look at Ye Heng, who had been injected with sedatives and was unconscious. Without any hesitation, he turned around and ran away into the distance.
King Kai smiled arrogantly, as if he didn't care about the enemy in front of him: "
Run, you weak warrior gods!
You are no match for me at all!
With his contemptuous laughter, King Kai raised the sword in his hand again and slashed at Ai Xi with all his strength.。
